description: Client Report Analytics: live, validated reports for ONE client, where the client is a connected Xero organisation, MYOB company file or QuickBooks company (named in full or in part, never a contact). Reports: Financial Overview, Health Check, Data Quality, GST Check, Client Queries, Summary of Tax Amounts by Type, BAS Related Transactions and GST, Contact Details for BAS, Sales and Purchases by Tracking Category, Activity Count, Actual Time, Estimate Accuracy, Ledger User Activity, the client report catalogue and each platform's standard reports. For any of these, load the matching client-report-analytics skill and create the report from its template; never write the report in chat.
name: client-report-analytics
